items.title: Zverev tops Medvedev, sets up showdown with Alcaraz for ATP Finals title
items.desc: Alexander Zverev has faced criticism for weeks about ascending to the No. 1 ranking without beating Carlos Alcaraz or Jannik Sinner. Now he's going to get a chance to face Alcaraz in the championship match of the ATP Finals on Sunday.

items.title: Daniil Medvedev beats Frances Tiafoe, faces Alexander Zverev in ATP Finals semis
items.desc: Daniil Medvedev defeated Frances Tiafoe 6-3, 6-4 on Friday to reach the semifinals of the ATP Finals, where he will face top-ranked Alexander Zverev.

items.title: Carlos Alcaraz in off-court 'challenge' to stay healthy for semis of ATP Finals
items.desc: Carlos Alcaraz completed ATP Finals group play with a perfect three wins and will face Ben Shelton in the semifinals.

items.title: ATP Tour unveils expanded compensation plan to benefit top 250 players
items.desc: The ATP Tour unveiled a new player compensation plan on Friday that is projected to exceed $350 million starting in 2028 and provide better pay for up to 250 players in men's tennis.

items.title: Shelton beats Jodar, joins Zverev, Alcaraz in semifinal round of ATP Finals
items.desc: Ben Shelton beat Rafael Jodar on Thursday to join Alexander Zverev and Carlos Alcaraz in the semifinal round of the ATP Finals in Turin, Italy.

items.title: Ash Barty, Shingo Kunieda elected to International Tennis Hall of Fame
items.desc: Ash Barty, a former world No. 1 and major champion, has been elected for induction in the International Tennis Hall of Fame, along with Shingo Kunieda, a Japanese player who won four Paralympic gold medals and 50 majors in wheelchair tennis.

items.title: Carlos Alcaraz cruises past Daniil Medvedev at ATP Finals despite leg issue
items.desc: Carlos Alcaraz kept up his strong end-of-season form Wednesday, defeating Daniil Medvedev in straight sets at the ATP Finals in Turin, Italy.

items.title: FAQ: Why Zverev's rise to world No. 1 provokes mixed feelings
items.desc: Alexander Zverev's climb to No. 1 presents a complicated scenario for fans, sponsors and media due to his history of domestic violence allegations.

items.title: Sloane Stephens' home targeted in burglary attempt, 3 arrested, per report
items.desc: The home of tennis star Sloane Stephens was targeted in a burglary attempt Tuesday night, law enforcement sources told ABC News, though no property was taken in the incident. Three men have been arrested, according to the LAPD.

items.title: Alexander Zverev officially notified of lawsuit by ex-partner in abuse case
items.desc: Top-ranked tennis player Alexander Zverev was officially notified of a lawsuit filed by his former partner during the middle of the season-ending ATP Finals on Wednesday.

items.title: Mirra Andreeva beats Elina Svitolina to win WTA Finals without losing a set
items.desc: Mirra Andreeva defeated Elina Svitolina 7-5, 6-3 to win the WTA Finals on Sunday without dropping a set over five matches at the season-ending championships.

items.title: Alexander Zverev improved to 7-0 vs. Ben Shelton, advancing to ATP Finals semis
items.desc: Top-ranked Alexander Zverev improved to 7-0 in his career vs. American Ben Shelton with a 6-2, 7-6 (4) win, Tuesday, to make the semifinals of the ATP Finals.

items.title: What does the future hold for the WTA Finals?
items.desc: After six host cities in seven years, the WTA Finals will enter a new era of stability for the marquee year-end event.

items.title: Carlos Alcaraz dominates Frances Tiafoe in ATP Finals opener
items.desc: Third-ranked Carlos Alcaraz kept up his strong end-of-the season form with a dominant 6-2, 6-2 victory over Frances Tiafoe in his opening match at the ATP Finals on Monday.

items.title: Alexander Zverev starts ATP Finals with convincing win over Rafael Jodar
items.desc: Aiming to punctuate the best year of his career with another big title, top-ranked Alexander Zverev got his ATP Finals campaign off to a strong start with a 6-4, 6-4 victory over debutant Rafael Jodar.

items.title: Mirra Andreeva is 1st teen in WTA Finals title match since Maria Sharapova
items.desc: Mirra Andreeva defeated Jessica Pegula 6-3, 6-4 to reach the WTA Finals title match. Elina Svitolina routed Wimbledon champion Linda Noskova 6-2, 6-1 in the other semifinal.

items.title: Sabalenka sorry for on-court outburst in loss to Svitolina, says fans upset her
items.desc: Aryna Sabalenka apologized for an on-court outburst in her three-set loss to Elina Svitolina at the WTA Finals, saying it was directed at a group of fans.

items.title: Karolina Muchova withdraws from WTA Finals due to illness
items.desc: Karolina Muchova withdrew from the WTA Finals on Friday with a gastrointestinal illness.

items.title: Elina Svitolina beats Aryna Sabalenka in 3 sets to reach semis at WTA Finals
items.desc: Elina Svitolina overcame Aryna Sabalenka 6-3, 3-6, 6-1 to reach the semifinals of the WTA Finals on Friday, winning on her fourth match point.

items.title: Katerina Siniakova clinches record 6th year-end WTA No. 1 doubles finish
items.desc: Katerina Siniakova has clinched her record sixth year-end finish as the world's top-ranked doubles player on the WTA Tour.

items.title: ATP Finals preview: Can Alcaraz close out the year with a big win?
items.desc: Alcaraz has returned from injury and is on a hot streak, while Americans Shelton and Tiafoe are hoping to challenge for the ATP Finals title.

items.title: Jessica Pegula advances in 3 sets at WTA Finals, ousting Coco Gauff
items.desc: Jessica Pegula fired a career-high 16 aces to advance to the semifinals of the WTA Finals in a three-set win against Linda Noskova, knocking out Coco Gauff from the $10 million, season-ending competition.

items.title: Waiting game pays off for Tiafoe as he heads into ATP Finals
items.desc: At 28, Frances Tiafoe has played in just about every tournament on tour. But this will be his first experience in the ATP Finals.

items.title: Coco Gauff opens 2026 WTA Finals with win vs. Jessica Pegula
items.desc: Coco Gauff defeated fellow American Jessica Pegula 6-4, 6-7 (5), 6-2 in her first match of the 2026 WTA Finals on Sunday.

items.title: Mirra Andreeva beats Aryna Sabalenka in straight sets to reach WTA Finals semis
items.desc: Mirra Andreeva won her WTA Finals round-robin group in emphatic fashion Wednesday, defeating Aryna Sabalenka 6-4, 6-0.

items.title: Linda Noskova reaches WTA Finals semis with win over Coco Gauff
items.desc: Linda Noskova became the first to qualify for the semifinal round of the WTA Finals, defeating Coco Gauff 6-3, 6-3 in 1 hour and 15 minutes on Tuesday.

items.title: Jannik Sinner (knee) plans return at Saudi exhibition in Aussie prep
items.desc: Jannik Sinner, who has not played since July with a knee injury, said Tuesday he aims to return at an exhibition in Saudi Arabia in late December.

items.title: Aryna Sabalenka picks up first win at WTA Finals, faces Mirra Andreeva next
items.desc: Aryna Sabalenka defeated Karolina Muchova 7-6 (2), 7-5 for her first win at the 2026 WTA Finals on Monday. The former world No. 1 will next face No. 3 seed Mirra Andreeva.

items.title: Carlos Alcaraz beats Ben Shelton to win Paris Masters title
items.desc: Carlos Alcaraz won his second straight title and fifth of the year with a straight-sets victory over Ben Shelton in the Paris Masters final.

items.title: American Claire Liu wins Hong Kong Tennis Open for her 1st career WTA title
items.desc: American Claire Liu defeated Alexandra Eala 6-3, 6-0 to win the Hong Kong Tennis Open for her first WTA title.

items.title: No. 1 Elena Rybakina withdraws from WTA Finals for medical reasons
items.desc: Top-ranked Elena Rybakina has withdrawn from the WTA Finals for medical reasons before the season-ending championships begin.

items.title: Carlos Alcaraz looking for 'revenge' against Ben Shelton in Paris Masters final
items.desc: Carlos Alcaraz reached his third final since the US Open when he beat Casper Ruud 6-4, 6-4 at the Paris Masters. Alcaraz will play Ben Shelton for the title.

items.title: Alcaraz, Shelton into Paris Masters semis; ATP Finals field set
items.desc: Carlos Alcaraz held off Taylor Fritz and Ben Shelton outlasted Tommy Paul to reach the Paris Masters semifinals while also finalizing the field for the ATP Finals.

items.title: Gaël Monfils stays in tennis as captain of France's Davis Cup team
items.desc: Gaël Monfils will stay in tennis as captain of France's Davis Cup team, the national federation said.

items.title: Alex Eala outlasts Maria Sakkari in rain-soaked Hong Kong Open semifinals, faces Claire Liu in final
items.desc: This puts Eala one win away from claiming her second WTA Tour title of the year.

items.title: Alex Eala survives Antonia Ruzic test, storms into Hong Kong Open semifinals against Maria Sakkari
items.desc: After surviving a tense opening-set tiebreak, the Filipina shifted into another gear to dismantle Croatia's Antonia Ruzic, 7-6(7), 7-5, and advance to the Hong Kong Open semifinals.

items.title: Ben Shelton tops Tommy Paul to reach first Paris Masters semifinal
items.desc: Ben Shelton won an all-American matchup against Tommy Paul on Friday to reach the semifinals of the Paris Masters for the first time.

items.title: Jessica Pegula: Hot mic comments about Mirra Andreeva an 'unfortunate situation'
items.desc: Tennis star Jessica Pegula told ESPN on Friday that her hot mic comments about Mirra Andreeva were an "unfortunate situation," before adding that the matter has been handled "privately."

items.title: Ben Shelton moves into Paris Masters quarters, to face Tommy Paul next
items.desc: Ben Shelton beat Arthur Rinderknech 3-6, 6-4, 7-6 (5) on Thursday for a season's best 43rd win and a spot in the Paris Masters quarterfinals. The US Open runner-up next faces No. 12 Tommy Paul in an all-American contest.

items.title: Elena Rybakina, Aryna Sabalenka lead season-ending WTA Finals groups
items.desc: Elena Rybakina and Aryna Sabalenka head their respective singles groups for the WTA Finals, with Coco Gauff and Jessica Pegula landing in the same group.

items.title: WTA Finals preview: Who to watch and who can win
items.desc: Can Coco Gauff or Jessica Pegula earn the WTA Finals title? Or will Rybakina continue her reign in 2026? What to know as the tournament begins Sunday.

items.title: Jannik Sinner replacing Darren Cahill with Magnus Norman on coaching team
items.desc: Jannik Sinner's partnership with coach Darren Cahill is ending after a spell that saw the Italian win five Grand Slam titles and achieve the No. 1 ranking.

items.title: Alex Eala finally gets past Tereza Valentová to book Hong Kong Open quarterfinal berth
items.desc: Alex Eala has finally claimed her first win over Tereza Valentová at the third time of asking to reach the Hong Kong Open quarterfinals.

items.title: Alexander Zverev loses first match as No. 1; Novak Djokovic also out in Paris
items.desc: Alexander Zverev's tenure as the No. 1 player in men's tennis started with a 7-6 (5), 6-2 defeat to Lorenzo Musetti, while Novak Djokovic saw his dwindling hopes of making the ATP Finals with a loss to qualifier Rinky Hijikata.

items.title: Alex Eala brushes aside late replacement Emerson Jones to reach Hong Kong Open round of 16
items.desc: Despite a late change in opponent, Alex Eala was still able to comfortably breeze through her opening match at the Hong Kong Open.

items.title: Novak Djokovic fends off Valentin Vacherot at Paris Masters
items.desc: Seven-time champion Novak Djokovic overcame a scare late in the second set to beat big-serving Valentin Vacherot in the first round of the Paris Masters.

items.title: Alexander Zverev rises to No. 1 men's tennis ranking after dominant season
items.desc: Alexander Zverev rose to No. 1 in the men's tennis ranking after a dominant season in which he won the French and US Open titles.

items.title: Ben Shelton adds coach Juan Carlos Ferrero to 2027 staff
items.desc: Carlos Alcaraz's former coach Juan Carlos Ferrero is joining Ben Shelton's coaching staff for the 2027 season.

items.title: Venus Williams loses in Guangzhou Open doubles semifinals
items.desc: Venus Williams and Janice Tjen lost to Polina Kudermetova and Maria Timofeeva 6-4, 6-7 (8), 10-6 in the Guangzhou Open doubles semifinals.

items.title: Leylah Fernandez advances to Tokyo WTA final with win over Rakhimova
items.desc: Leylah Fernandez has advanced to her third WTA final of the year, with a chance to win her second tournament.
